mageck_runtime.instrumentation_note: The environment did not provide /usr/bin/time, so the run used the shell's portable time -p output and peak memory was not measured.

protocol.dotmatch_command: dotmatch count --targets yusa_library.csv --reads ERR376998.fastq.gz --reads ERR376999.fastq.gz --sample-label plasmid,ESC1 --target-start 23 --target-length 19 --k 0 --metric hamming --format mageck --out dotmatch-0.6.1.counts.tsv --summary dotmatch-0.6.1.summary.json
protocol.mageck_command: mageck count -l yusa_library.csv -n escneg --sample-label plasmid,ESC1 --trim-5 23 --sgrna-len 19 --fastq ERR376998.fastq.gz ERR376999.fastq.gz
protocol.comparison_semantics: sgRNA-keyed; exact Gene strings; integer counts; row-order independent

independent_check: After preserving each header and sorting all data rows by sgRNA with LC_ALL=C, cmp reported byte-identical canonical tables.
failure_criteria: Fail on a pinned input/hash mismatch, abnormal tool exit, partial output, guide-set difference, gene mismatch, integer count mismatch, or mapped-total disagreement.
negative_results: The original resource wrapper could not run because /usr/bin/time was absent; no scientific command ran in that attempt, and portable shell timing was used for the successful run.
No missing guides, extra guides, gene mismatches, count mismatches, or mapped-total disagreements were found.
claim_boundary: This establishes complete count-table agreement between DotMatch 0.6.1 and a pinned MAGeCK 0.5.9.5 implementation for the full public ERR376998/ERR376999 Yusa workflow under exact fixed-offset semantics. It does not determine which implementation is biologically correct, validate downstream inference, benchmark performance under controlled conditions, or demonstrate external adoption.
